newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on talk of Indonesia buying.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on talk of Indonesia buying.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Feb (3rd pos) 1,219 rgt/tonne Nov (south) 1,215
Open/Hi/Low 1,215/1,223/1,210 Prev close 1,195
Prev settlement 1,198 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices firmed on talk of Indonesian buying of olein and gains in soyoil. Trading activity picked up in the afternoon on more speculative buying and switching activities. Expectation of more tenders and technical buying also helped sentiment.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also surged on buying from refiners, interest was seen from all regions in nearby CPOs.
The surge was also attributed to technical buying, with a lot buying interest seen from 1,215 till 1,220 for new trading month February futures, they said.
Some profit-taking was seen towards the close, with February futures closing 21 ringgit higher at 1,219 ringgit ($482.96) a tonne, after trading in 13-ringgit range.

For most-active January futures contract, technical support was seen from 1,210 to 1,215 ringgit. It closed at 1,213 ringgit, up 19 ringgit from Friday. Other contracts posted double-digits rises. "Sentiment looks firm as players were optimistic of an upward trend in the near-term," a dealer said.
"All traded contracts have breached the 1,200 ringgit level and, technically we feel that there is a tendency for more gains on expectations of export demand," he said.
Trading volume also increased because of more switching activities and final turnover was at 2,500 lots, up from 2,308 lots on Friday.
Expectation of fresh tenders this week also firmed the market which saw the Pakistanis buying some tonnages last week.
The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan on last Thursday bought 4,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil at $529.40 per tonne for shipment by December 10.
Physicals prices were firm throughout, traders said.

Physical Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,215 ringgit a tonne with bids at 1,210 after trading from 1,202.50 and 1,215. Nov (central) was offered at 1,210 ringgit with bids at 1,202.50 and Nov (north) saw offers at 1,205 and bids at 1,200.
Dec (south) was offered at 1,225 ringgit with bids at 1,220, after trading from 1,210 to 1,225.
Dec (central) saw offers at 1,220 ringgit and bids at 1,210, and Dec (south) at 1,215 against 1,202.50.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $517.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $517.50. Dec was traded at $512.50.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $557.50 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $555. Dec was traded at $550 and $552.50.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $380 and Jan at $385.
Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
